description: Deep green floor-length tailored overdress over cream linen underdress, low square neckline and elbow-length sleeves. Fine gold knotwork borders at neckline, bodice seams, cuffs, belt and front skirt edges; paired round shoulder brooches and central round belt fitting with hanging woven end. Brown-and-green plaid shawl with broad gold knotwork edges and fringe rests at the forearms. Brown leather shoe visible beneath centre hem; opposite foot largely under opaque skirt. Both hands visible. No headgear, armor or weapon.
